findings.issue: Browser delayed-response test delays the initial reviewer-choice read, changes selected plan, then asserts the original result is present; it does not demonstrate stale response is discarded. No delayed assignment write response is tested across project/plan/session/credential/membership/refresh changes. API suite does not test role revocation or a concurrent membership-revocation/decision serialization race.

Criteria call for persistence and idempotent migration are only partially covered: restart reopens same database and observes assignment, but test does not start from legacy schema/data, invoke migration twice explicitly, or compare historical terminal/archive assignment metadata preservation. Reopen may incidentally rerun init, but this is not a reliable idempotent migration assertion.

positive_observations: PUT assignment rechecks caller token credential, expiry, role and explicit grant in transaction; assignment uses expected revision, no-op skips audit, update and audit share transaction.
Decision route locks plan and project, rechecks live credential/grant/approver role, excludes author and gates assigned reviewer before established integrity checks.

Test covers self-claim, requester assignment, clear path absent (there is no positive clear assertion), reassignment absent, Unicode reviewer ID, stale revision, no-op audit count, concurrent conflicting assignments, assignment/decision race, expiry/grant/credential revocation, foreign plan, bootstrap, archive, restart, protected source/intent and comment preservation, NOT_EXECUTED.
Migration is additive IF NOT EXISTS, reviewer ID nullable, revision bigint nonnegative default 0.
limitations: Native implementation still changing; hashes identify this observation only and final verdict requires frozen commit.

corrected_reachability.reviewer_list_authorization: Prior blocker withdrawn. Shared authenticate preHandler covers all /api/projects/ paths, authenticates the exact active token, and under ENFORCED mode checks actorHasProjectGrant for req.params.projectId before route logic. The endpoint therefore is not reachable by an ungranted authenticated actor. A narrow revoke-after-preHandler race remains subject to the existing T21 current-read semantics; this is not an endpoint-specific absent-auth finding.
corrected_reachability.browser_stale_test: The test releases a delayed first reviewer-list response after selecting another plan and receiving that plan’s list, but it asserts candidate presence only before releasing the delayed response. There is no post-release assertion that the selected plan’s candidates remain correct / stale candidates absent, so it would pass if the delayed response overwrote current choices.
